prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Preview companion animations and desktop interactions before adopting.", "Interactive Pet Animations", "Select Companion Style"]
1: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Sign in now to backup your companion so it is never lost or reset.", "Signing in ensures your pet syncs across device restarts."]
2: ["Master Desktop Controls", "Quickly learn how to summon, move, talk to, and hide your pet on your desktop.", "Click to talk; Drag to position; Right-click taskbar icon to hide"]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Pet Type", "Answer two quick questions to find out which pet creation path fits your setup best.", "Instant Pet vs Custom Photo Pet", "Choose Your Path", "Select standard preset companion or upload photos for a custom companion."]
4: ["Upload well-lit front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet rendering."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop...", "Your pet model is rendering. Make sure your desktop taskbar permits overlay apps.", "Tip: If pet disappears, click the tray icon to bring it back."]
6: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Pet Data", "Log in to bind your pet to your account cloud backup so your pet never resets.", "Use your primary email to ensure seamless pet recovery."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "Try the interactive shortcuts below to get comfortable managing your pet.", "Desktop Shortcuts Demo", "Test Pet Menu"]
8: ["Official Adoption Completed", "Your companion certificate is ready. Click below to spawn your pet on desktop.", "Certified Companion"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets!", "Adopt your desktop companion today and unlock free starter accessories!", "Your Onboarding Guide"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information by requesting the user's primary email address.
